list: Official PS5 list: 55 trophies, 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden. Names, descriptions and grades as Exophase and PSNProfiles listed them on 2026-11-18, cross-checked against Push Square, Planet GTA 6, GTABase, Insider Gaming and EGamers on 2026-11-21. Guides are this entry's own words; a trophy whose method no guide has confirmed yet says so instead of guessing.

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. Nothing here needs online play or DLC: every trophy on the list is single-player. Expect a long haul — PowerPyx rates the platinum 4/10 and about 200 hours, Push Square says 300 hours or more.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Story trophy. Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, through to the end — it unlocks when the mission completes. Nothing to prepare and nothing to miss.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. Just keep playing the main missions; it unlocks at the end of the chapter. Do the balcony meditation (see Positive Mental Attitude) before the chapter ends, though — that one may not wait.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the in-game checklist, which appears under Touch Pad > Progress > 100% Completion once the story is done. You do not need literally everything — for example 15 of the 18 card sets and 70 of the 80 challenges count — but it is the longest grind on the list and the hardest trophy. Work through the roadmap stages first and let this one fill up as you go.
trophies.name: A Long Road

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. That is a little over half of them, so skip the ones that fight you. Track them under Touch Pad > Progress > Activities > Stunts, and find stunt spots on the map under Exploration.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. Just sample everything as you explore Leonida — one go at each type is enough, no wins or medals needed.
trophies.name: Master of None

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, across the two ranges: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero. Find them under Touch Pad > Activities > Shooting Ranges. Most challenges have three difficulty tiers, and some stay locked until you meet their conditions, which the map shows.
trophies.name: The Shootist

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. Some races charge an entry fee. Find the locations under Touch Pad > Activities > Drones > Top Fun Drones.
trophies.name: Top Fun

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — winning the same race twenty times does not count. Race spots appear as you explore; track them under Touch Pad > Activities > Racing. Most spots let you hire a car, and your own car's rating can be raised with upgrades from mod shops.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fairly early on, Cal asks you to catch a parrotfish over 2 kg: fish in the marked area from a boat with a rod — plenty of boats nearby can be borrowed if you do not own one.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game — any machine, any game. Arcades are scattered around Leonida; one full playthrough of a single game is all it takes.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish all of Andy's missions; the trophy pops after his last one. Stranger strands like Andy's also count toward Strangers & Freaks, so clear them together.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's strand; the final mission is called Maritime Disputes. Stranger strands also count toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's strand; the final mission is called Hometown Heroes. Stranger strands also count toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers appear as you explore; work through their chains to the end — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each have one, so you are most of the way there once their strands are done.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's strand; his missions revolve around fetching vehicles from his wish list. Stranger strands also count toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's strand; his chain runs through the Kitty Litter labs. Stranger strands also count toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. A meditation only counts once its closing zen animation has played. Track them under Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations, and find discovered spots on the map under Exploration. POSSIBLY MISSABLE: one optional meditation at Jason's house is only available in Chapter 1 — after the Down to Earth mission, on a following morning, follow Lucia to the balcony when she says she is going to meditate, and accept when she offers to teach you. It adds to the counter but is not listed as a spot, and it is unconfirmed whether the trophy needs it, so do it anyway and keep a separate save. The last spot, Ascent on Mount Kalaga, needs both characters and opens after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

The Gamers Hub — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. No published guide has yet confirmed which animal or where it is, so this entry flags the method as unconfirmed rather than guessing — check the linked guides again later in the launch window.
trophies.name: Fair Game

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list
GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets; there are 18 sets in the game. Cards you have collected can be sold at pawn shops and still count toward your progress. Track them under Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards. Going for 100% completion needs 15 sets, so this one falls out of that grind.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app on Jason's or Lucia's phone (hold Up): landmarks (31), curiosities (35) and sculptures (23) all count, so there are more than enough to choose from. Track your count under Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the game's 80 challenges — the in-game achievement-style tasks listed under Touch Pad > Progress > Challenges. 70 of them are needed for 100% completion, so push past 50 while you are there.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape. Set it up in free roam: pick a fast car, a quiet escape route out of the city, and a place to lay low until the stars clear.
trophies.name: Hot Together

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your wanted level — the heat has to stay on through all three, so plan a tight route between three close shops and keep moving.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Getting inside one counts, and so does scanning it with the WAiNK app. It comes naturally over a story playthrough; track what you have found under Touch Pad > Progress > Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Down 5 enemies during a single use of Combat Focus. Pick a crowded fight, wait until several enemies are grouped, then trigger it and work through them before it ends.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the Vice City International Airport. The official description is the only confirmed detail so far — no published guide has verified a method yet, so this entry does not invent one. Check the linked guides again later in the launch window.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.guide: Official hint only: 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos.' The Rhino is the tank, so the trophy involves one, but no published guide has verified how — flagged unconfirmed rather than guessed.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: no alarms, no witnesses spotting you, and leave before anyone raises the alarm.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Plan the getaway before you go in — the escape counts as much as the robbery.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run set routes around Leonida — intercept one, crack it open, and lose the police before the trophy pops.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — every named area of the map (reported as 52 areas). Drive, fly and walk through uncovered regions until the map is filled in; the game tracks explored areas as you go.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list
Planet GTA 6 — GTA 6 Trophies

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang (reported as 9 gangs). Hit one operation per gang; gang operations are marked as you discover them around Leonida.
trophies.name: Pest Control

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find a bar spot overlooking the beach, order a drink, and take in the view — the trophy is about the moment, not a mission.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive straight out through the glass, the way the series has always done it.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Despite the name, this is a robbery, not a bowling game. Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is a gang operation, first marked by the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Take its three valuables — the luxury watch in the southeast office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the northeast table, and the safe in the northeast hallway office (bring sticky bombs) — then lose the police. The robbery takes a long time to come back, but it does respawn, so it is not missable.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
The Gamers Hub — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: Max out the Strength stat on both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Work out at fitness clubs together after Coffee Break in Chapter 2 — while one character trains, the partner trains too, so train them side by side.
trophies.name: Personal Best

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
The Gamers Hub — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your criminal profile — stealth robberies, wounding instead of killing, and other violent choices. The counter sits on the trophy itself, and most players earn it naturally over a full playthrough, so do not grind it early.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide
The Gamers Hub — GTA 6 Trophy List

trophies.guide: Official hint only: 'Second time's the charm.' PowerPyx suspects a link to the Payday Loans stores, but no method is confirmed yet — flagged unconfirmed rather than guessed.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

sources.name: The Gamers Hub — GTA 6 Trophy List
Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.guide: Official hint only: 'What the hell just happened?' No published guide has verified a method yet — flagged unconfirmed rather than guessed.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by: knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. Line up a slow pass past a pedestrian and swing as you go by.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies; launder them as you go rather than hoarding them, and the total builds up over the playthrough.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothes, gear, anything counts. Find shops on the map under Touch Pad > Style. It is the easiest trophy on the list; it just takes money.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties through the Vice City Real Estate phone app: Mitchel Auto Center $4,000; 7th Avenue Garage $12,000; Vela Rota Drive Garage $24,000; Persistence Road Garage $7,600; Wyatt Motors $21,600; Bonita Court Garage $34,000; Atlantic Court Garage $40,000; Store n' Bolt $16,800 — $160,000 in total. Each garage adds one parking spot, which also helps with On the Spot.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 different vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Register a vehicle you are driving at any Pay 'N' Spray or Mod Shop — you need a free parking spot, and the fee depends on the vehicle's value. Buying garages adds spots, so do Little Boxes first if you are short.
trophies.name: On the Spot

sources.name: Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
